title: On the Practical Impact of Local Linear Instabilities in Entropy-Stable Schemes
summary: Local linear instability refers to the linearized discrete operator exhibiting perturbation growth exceeding that of the corresponding continuous linearized problem. In the context of nonlinear entropy-stable discretizations, we argue that local linear instabilities should be interpreted as a source of numerical error whose practical impact is often negligible compared with other discretization errors.
